description: Defines the pusch_tpmi_select_info class for managing Transmit Precoding Matrix Indicator (TPMI) information in PUSCH, including methods for retrieving TPMI data based on channel conditions and constants related to 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_tpmi_select_info
classes.description: Class managing TPMI information for PUSCH, providing access to TPMI data based on number of layers.

methods.name: get_max_nof_layers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of layers supported.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the TPMI information is valid (not empty).

methods.name: get_tpmi_select
methods.description: Retrieves TPMI info for a specified number of layers, with range assertion.

methods.name: pusch_tpmi_select_info (constructor from span)
methods.description: Initializes TPMI info from a span of tpmi_info.

methods.name: pusch_tpmi_select_info (constructor from initializer list)
methods.description: Initializes TPMI info from an initializer list.

methods.name: pusch_tpmi_select_info (copy constructor)
methods.description: Creates a copy of existing TPMI info object.
